name: Rome Cavalieri
positioning: Rome Cavalieri, A Waldorf Astoria Hotel: a hotel on Rome's highest hilltop, set in 15 acres of Mediterranean parkland with pools, tennis and a large private art collection
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet, resort-style base above the city with shuttle access to Via Veneto
Families visiting Rome in summer, when the complimentary kids club runs
Art lovers who want to tour a private collection with a resident art historian

facts.text: The hotel is set on Rome's highest hilltop, with panoramic views of the city and St. Peter's Dome.
The hotel sits in 15 acres of Mediterranean parkland at the top of Monte Mario, with Aleppo pines and palms.
The Rome Cavalieri first opened in 1963 and joined the Waldorf Astoria collection in 2008.
La Pergola is the hotel's rooftop restaurant from chef Heinz Beck.
La Pergola's wine list draws on a cellar of over 70,000 bottles.
Uliveto, beside the outdoor pool, serves Mediterranean and international dishes and a Sunday brunch.
Tiepolo Lounge and Terrace serves cocktails and aperitivo, sometimes with live jazz in the evening.
The Cavalieri Grand Spa Club centers on an amethyst Turkish bath framed by marble platforms and Roman mosaics.
Besides the main pool, the park has two family-friendly pools, one just for small children, and there is an indoor pool under a glass dome.
Two floodlit clay tennis courts meet Davis Cup standard.
An 800-metre fitness trail runs through the hotel's gardens.
Pets are welcome, with a pet-sitting service and a pet spa.

highlights.text: The hotel houses more than a thousand artworks dating from the fourteenth century to today, and guests can tour the collection with a resident art historian.
The Penthouse Suite has a sliding glass ceiling that opens onto a private rooftop garden with a hot tub looking toward St. Peter's Dome.
Guests over seven can train as gladiators in the hotel's park with instructors from Rome's Gladiatorial School.
The Napoleon Suite includes a writing desk once owned by Napoleon.
Guests in Imperial Rooms or Suites can use the seventh-floor Imperial Club, with complimentary snacks and drinks through the day.

considerations.text: The hotel is about a 15-minute drive into the city; a free hourly shuttle bus runs to and from Via Veneto.
The IT Club kids club, complimentary for hotel guests aged 4 to 12, is available in summer.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that suits special-occasion travelers.
